proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.spawned_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary effect is to summon and command a creature, but summon-capable mechanics families are spell-only. Magic items cannot currently express create_companion/command_companion behavior directly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental"

proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreatureMechanics.catalog_ref_stat_block
proposed_widenings.justification: The item names an external monster identity rather than shipping an inline stat block. Current spawned-creature support requires authored inline creature stats, which would be dishonest here.

notes: No content JSON or trace was authored. The item is a magic-item summon with command/dismiss/reset behavior, but current summon mechanics are spell-only and inline-stat-block-based.
